desc.T1: The hero image is usually the largest contentful paint element; lazy-loading it delays its load, so it cannot cut LCP.
desc.T2: React state does not sanitize anything, and dangerouslySetInnerHTML bypasses React's escaping, so this renders user HTML and enables XSS.
desc.T3: Placeholder text is not a label: it disappears on input and is not reliably announced, so replacing labels makes the form less accessible.
desc.T4: Images are not part of the JavaScript bundle, so converting PNG to WebP cannot shrink it.
